article_cyberchondria.summary: A headache searched online becomes a brain tumor within three clicks. This article explains cyberchondria: how self-diagnosis fuels health anxiety, why scary results rise to the top of search pages, how the nocebo effect turns information into symptoms, and how to use medical information without being used by it.
article_cyberchondria.title: Cyberchondria: When Every Symptom Becomes a Disease

article_job_interview.summary: An interview introduction is not a biography. It is a short, structured answer that tells the interviewer who you are, why you are relevant and what you want next. After reading this you can prepare a 60-second introduction, describe your experience with evidence, ask questions that show judgement, and close the interview and follow up in a way that is remembered.
article_job_interview.title: How to Introduce Yourself in a Job Interview
